title: 給食・お弁当・卒業のフレーム
subject_en: Decorative frames with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, landscape or square, thick enough to hold text or a photo. Flat colourful style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 給食・お弁当・卒業・遠足など、学校行事と季節の飾り枠12点です。写真や文字を入れるおたより、掲示物に使えます。
